generation_history.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Modular BOOTS PAIR for Santi Wong. Image1Santi reference design and image2Santi turnaround are exact costume authority: stout darkwarmbrown calfheight pirate workboots, big rounded toes, chunky short heels/soles, folded cuff/upperstrap and modest brass rectangular buckles plus lower ankle straps. Short sturdy proportions, NOT Captain's tall flared ridingboots. Image3Captain boots is paired-view workflow/cartoon style only.
One PAIR of boots as one modular model, no feet/legs/skin, trousers or belt. Each boot hollow opening at calf; leather straps attached, buckle holes visible where meaningful, stylized smooth sculpted leather with broad simple highlights, no realistic grain. Pair toe directions forward infront and rearheelvisibleinback, both spaced at Santi's slight apart stance. Exact profiles naturally overlap the farboot so one dominant side silhouette, not split two differentboots or turn each boot separately. Keep foot length/sole thickness and calf height same across4views, front/back group contain2boots separated by small whitegap.
A single horizontal row of EXACTLY FOUR view GROUPS FRONT LEFT BACK RIGHT, frontpair/leftpair/backpair/rightpair. Four EQUAL WIDTH INVISIBLE CELLS so cutter --count4 groups bothboots correctly, large margins inside eachcell. Level orthographic cameras, same totalheight and common lowestsolebaseline at one scale. Every boot fullyvisible, no clipping. Pure flat white255 background, no castshadows/scenery/labels/text/arrows/borders/groundline or otherobjects.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix ONLY the BOOT PAIR CAMERA PROJECTION in the second and fourth cells. Current left/right are tilted three-quarter product views with both boots staggered diagonally. Replace with strict LEVEL ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE ELEVATIONS of the exact same pair fixed at equal footdepth. In second LEFT view both toes point LEFT, farboot naturally overlaps behind nearboot and only ONE main boot side silhouette should show (no stagger). Fourth RIGHT view toesRIGHT, same natural farboot occlusion, ONE main side silhouette. Opticalaxis horizontal, no topdown angle, no perspective or 3/4. Do not invent another pose for the pair. FIRST FRONT and THIRD BACK pair views keep their design unchanged, but match camera level, no top surfaces seen from above. Keep boot shapes, cuffs, brassbuckles and leather finish exactly, same totalheight and sharedsolebaseline, one scale all4. Entire pair in each of4equalwidth cells FRONT LEFT BACK RIGHT. No skin or trousers, no text or labels. Plainwhite no ground or cast shadows. Correct matching buckle placement with outward cuffbuckles, mirrored on left/rightboots, rear stays plain. The change is accurate orthographic projection, not a boot redesign.
